sources.title: Altera Agilex 3/5 Booting User Guide 26.3, Reset
sources.finding: CPU software reset does not affect SDM; HPS cold/warm resets do not reconfigure FPGA; reset scope is not whole-device transaction retirement.

sources.title: Agilex 5 configuration guide 26.1, reset response table
sources.finding: SDM reset and boot ROM restart are marked for power cycle, not nCONFIG or HPS_COLD_nRESET.

sources.title: Agilex 5 ES errata applicability, 2026-10-02
sources.finding: F2H/SMMU/reconfiguration erratum lists ES A5Ex065B/A parts ending R0; sealed target A5EB013BB23BE4SCS is not listed as affected. This is not a fresh physical silicon identification.

sources.title: Agilex 5 ES erratum 2.1.21
sources.finding: Describes repeated F2H configuration/reset failures with SMMU and no workaround for its listed affected devices; symptom similarity is insufficient attribution.

open_questions: Vendor source-DATA acknowledgment and end-to-end NoC retirement guarantees for this exact nonsecure stream path.
Whether any supported JTAG sequence restarts SDM itself; fresh SPL/HPS/fabric observations alone do not prove this.
Exact silicon revision and applicability of other SMMU/CPU cache-maintenance errata on the physical kit.
